messages:
Ava (product): Quick announce — Hosted API v3 is GA. This ships a unified streaming + tool-calling endpoint and consolidated model routing. Rolling to all hosted regions over the next 24h. Docs: https://docs.redwood.ai/hosted/v3/streaming

Diego (eng): Huge thanks to infra & runtime. Highlights: single /v3/generate replaces /chat and /generate endpoints, streaming + function calls in one flow, improved batching defaults. SDK bump to @redwood/sdk v3.0.0 required for full compatibility.

Maya (eng-ops): Canary in us-west-2 finished with no regressions. Fallback routing enabled: when primary variant is saturated we auto-route to quantized-compatible fallback (rwd-small-q4). Monitoring for 48h.

Liam (infra): NOTE for integrators: new header to control fallback behavior -> X-Redwood-Fallback: prefer|avoid|force. Quick curl example:

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v3/generate 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
  -H 'X-Redwood-Fallback: prefer' 
  -d '{"model":"rwd-medium-2026","input":"Summarize...","stream":true}'
```

Diego (eng): Tool-calling policy change: account-level opt-in required. To enable tool-calls for your org, flip `account_tool_calls` in the Console or via the Admin API. This helps prevent accidental remote execution during early rollout.

Ava (product): For Dedicated/Private customers: API compatibility shims are available — reach out to your AM for migration schedules and testing windows.

DeployBot: rollout:hosted v3 -> canary:us-west-2 ✅  regional rollout started at 1787123478, estimated global completion ~1787127056.

Ethan (cto): Heads-up to teams — watch P95 token latency and the cost dashboard for the next 2 days. If you see any >2x jump, tag #eng-sre and ping me. Awesome job all around. :tada:

Liam (infra): If you run into model mismatch errors, use the Model-Alias header to pin: `Model-Alias: rwd-medium-2026` or update model pinning in the Console.

Maya (eng-ops): Action items for product/dev teams: 1) Update quickstarts and templates to SDK v3.0.0, 2) Verify tool-call opt-in settings, 3) Review fallback header usage for custom routing. Please confirm completion in this thread.

Ava (product): tl;dr — v3 GA: unified streaming endpoint, combined tool-calls (opt-in), automatic fallback routing, SDK v3.0.0. Migration guide & checklist: https://docs.redwood.ai/hosted/v3/migration  

Diego (eng): :shipit:  Thanks everyone — will post a short blog and migrate the example apps after lunch.

Maya (eng-ops): Confirmed quickstarts patch scheduled for EOD.

Liam (infra): I'll drop a short snippet in the infra-runbook about the new headers.

Ethan (cto): Congrats team. Keep an eye on support traffic.
